quality_gates.comparison_rule: all quality gates define eligibility; outcome_mcc ranks eligible epochs
limitations: recovery-outcome semantics use proper causal transitions
bbox IoU thresholds are minimum functionality gates, not 90-percent claims
full training remains separately gated from this mini experiment

train.contract: finite x/y, positive width/height, and the complete box must stay inside the actual state_before image

validation.contract: finite x/y, positive width/height, and the complete box must stay inside the actual state_before image
